title: 真鍮の圧力と深海鏡の共鳴
author: 歯車屋 ギィ

en.title: Resonance of Brass Pressure and the Deep-Sea Mirror
en.premise: When the atmospheric pressure regulator—the lifeline of the floating city—reaches the end of its lifespan, the world drifts toward a slow, silent suffocation. The only hope is to restart the legendary master clock sleeping within submerged ruins. Guy, a clumsy genius mechanic, builds a brass diving shell capable of withstanding crushing water pressures and plunges into the dark ocean depths. Down below, what he discovers is the 'Deep-Sea Mirror,' which perfectly projects the internal mechanics of machinery, and a massive gear frozen in time.

zh.title: 黄铜压力与深海镜的共鸣
zh.premise: 作为浮动都市生命线的“大气压调节器”即将迎来寿命终结，世界正走向慢性窒息。唯一的希望，是重新启动沉睡于海底遗迹中的传说主钟。笨拙的天才技师基伊（Guy）组装了能够承受水压的黄铜潜水壳，潜入黑暗的深海海底。在那里，他所发现的，是将机械内部结构完美投影的“深海镜”，以及一枚静止不动的巨大齿轮。
